mapper.select: SELECT bank_account_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_alias, balance, is_primary, imported_at FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND registered_person_id IS NULL AND imported_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY is_primary DESC, bank_account_id

SELECT bank_account_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_alias, balance, is_primary, imported_at FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bank_account_id = #{accountId} AND registered_person_id IS NULL AND imported_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT bank_account_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_alias, balance, is_primary, imported_at FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND registered_person_id IS NULL ORDER BY imported_at IS NULL, is_primary DESC, bank_account_id

SELECT bank_account_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_alias, balance, is_primary, imported_at FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bank_account_id = #{accountId} AND registered_person_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND registered_person_id IS NULL AND imported_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT rp.registered_person_id, rp.name, rp.relationship, rp.profile_image_key, ba.bank_account_id AS account_id, ba.bank_code, ba.bank_name, ba.account_number, ba.account_alias FROM registered_persons rp LEFT JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.registered_person_id = rp.registered_person_id AND ba.user_id = rp.user_id WHERE rp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rp.registered_person_id, ba.bank_account_id

SELECT rp.registered_person_id, rp.name, rp.relationship, rp.profile_image_key, ba.bank_account_id AS account_id, ba.bank_code, ba.bank_name, ba.account_number, ba.account_alias FROM registered_persons rp LEFT JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.registered_person_id = rp.registered_person_id AND ba.user_id = rp.user_id WHERE rp.user_id = #{userId} AND rp.registered_person_id = #{registeredPersonId} ORDER BY ba.bank_account_id

SELECT rp.registered_person_id, rp.name, rp.relationship, rp.profile_image_key, ba.bank_account_id AS account_id, ba.bank_code, ba.bank_name, ba.account_number, ba.account_alias FROM registered_persons rp JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.registered_person_id = rp.registered_person_id AND ba.user_id = rp.user_id WHERE rp.user_id = #{userId} AND rp.registered_person_id = #{registeredPersonId} AND ba.bank_account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registered_persons (user_id, name, relationship, profile_image_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{relationship}, #{profileImageKey})

INSERT INTO bank_accounts ( user_id, registered_person_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_alias, account_pin_hash, balance, is_primary ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{registeredPersonId}, #{bankCode}, #{bankName}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountAlias}, NULL, NULL, FALSE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financial_patterns fp JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.bank_account_id = fp.linked_bank_account_id AND ba.user_id = fp.user_id WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND ba.registered_person_id = #{registeredPersonId}
